meta.title: Teona Hotel | A City Stay in Central İzmit
meta.description: Teona Hotel in central İzmit offers 44 rooms across Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin types, plus Payidar Restaurant, a meeting room, fitness facilities and a sauna.

home.title: Close to the rhythm of the city, with time to unwind
home.subtitle: Since 2010, Teona Hotel has welcomed guests with 44 rooms and a range of facilities for a practical city stay.
home.introTitle: A practical stay in central İzmit
home.introBody: With 44 rooms across five room types, Teona Hotel brings Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna together under one roof.
home.roomsTitle: Five room options for your stay
home.roomsBody: Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin rooms provide options for different bed arrangements and stay requirements.
home.economyBody: A simple and practical room for your time in central İzmit.
home.frenchBody: A room prepared for guests who prefer a double French bed.
home.suiteBody: A room type for guests who prefer a larger accommodation area.
home.tripleBody: A room type with a bed layout suited to three guests.
home.twinBody: A room prepared for two guests who prefer separate beds.
home.amenitiesBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre, a sauna and a meeting room with flexible seating arrangements are available at the hotel.
home.restaurantTitle: A place to meet within the hotel
home.restaurantBody: Payidar Traditional Restaurant hosts live music programmes and group events.
home.locationBody: Teona Hotel's central İzmit location offers a practical starting point for your time in the city.

rooms.title: Five room types across 44 rooms
rooms.intro: Teona Hotel offers Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin room options in central İzmit.
rooms.photoNote: Room interiors may vary according to room type and bed configuration.
rooms.economyBody: A simple and practical choice for guests seeking a central city stay.
rooms.frenchBody: A room option prepared for guests who prefer a double French bed.
rooms.suiteBody: An option for guests who prefer a larger accommodation area during their stay.
rooms.tripleBody: A room with a bed layout suited to families or small groups of three.
rooms.twinBody: Prepared for two guests who prefer separate beds in the same room.
rooms.sharedBody: Guests can use Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna. The meeting room accommodates 40 people in a U-shape and 80 in a classroom layout.

shared.facilitiesBody: At Teona Hotel, Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna are available to guests during their stay.
shared.ctaTitle: Let us help plan your stay
shared.ctaBody: Contact Teona Hotel directly for availability, bed configuration and reservation details.

economy.title: Economy Room
economy.intro: The Economy Room is a simple and practical option for a city stay in central İzmit.
economy.detailTitle: A practical room for city plans
economy.body1: The Economy Room brings essential accommodation needs together in a functional layout.
economy.body2: During your stay, you can use Wi-Fi, satellite TV and the hotel's shared facilities.

french.title: French Room
french.intro: The French Room is prepared for guests who prefer a double French bed.
french.body1: The French bed layout provides a room experience suited to double occupancy.
french.body2: During your stay, you can use Wi-Fi, satellite TV and the hotel's shared facilities.

suite.title: Suite Room
suite.intro: The Suite Room is offered to guests who prefer a larger accommodation area.
suite.body1: The Suite Room brings rest and accommodation together in a more spacious room layout.
suite.body2: It is suitable for guests who want more space during their time in the city.

triple.title: Triple Room
triple.intro: The Triple Room offers a bed layout suited to three guests.
triple.body1: The Triple Room is arranged around the accommodation needs of three people travelling together.
triple.body2: During your stay, you can use Wi-Fi, satellite TV and the hotel's shared facilities.

twin.title: Twin Room
twin.intro: The Twin Room is prepared for guests who prefer two separate beds in the same room.
twin.detailTitle: A flexible stay with separate beds
twin.body1: The twin-bed layout is suitable for two people travelling together who prefer separate beds.
twin.body2: During your stay, you can use Wi-Fi, satellite TV and the hotel's shared facilities.

about.title: In İzmit since 2010
about.lead: Teona Hotel serves guests in central İzmit with 44 rooms and a range of on-site facilities.
about.body1: The hotel's 44-room collection includes Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin room types.
about.body2: According to the hotel's promotional material, approximately 120,000 guests have stayed here to date. Teona Hotel also houses Payidar Traditional Restaurant and a meeting room that can be arranged in different layouts.
about.principleTitle: A practical approach to city stays
about.principleBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna bring together the core facilities guests may need during their stay.
about.cityBody: Its central location makes Teona Hotel a practical accommodation option for business and city plans in İzmit.

restaurant.title: A setting made for gathering around the table
restaurant.lead: Located within Teona Hotel, Payidar Traditional Restaurant provides a dedicated setting for dining and gatherings.
restaurant.body1: The restaurant hosts live music programmes for evening gatherings.
restaurant.body2: For information and planning enquiries regarding group events, please contact the hotel directly.
